invariants: Monetary products use integer minor units and BigInt intermediate arithmetic; no binary decimal price-times-litres, basis-point discount or split-fee product.
A litre/percentage input is parsed to integer hundredths from its string/number representation; excess precision, coercible objects/arrays, scientific notation and unsupported bounds are rejected.
Discount/fuel/split ratios retain explicit nonnegative half-up rounding exactly once after multiplication.
All monetary returned values are bounded safe integer kobo; invalid ratios or out-of-range final results are refused.

Provider transfer and plan amounts use the already established documented v3 major-unit decimal parser; missing, malformed, sub-kobo or oversized provider evidence never becomes a rounded matching payment/plan.
Invalid transfer evidence remains unknown without initiating another transfer; invalid plan money produces checked:false/stale:true with a review error.
Existing wallet station/code integrity, immutable quote persistence, transaction locks/idempotency and historical recorded-discount semantics remain intact.
